_comment: Runs on a personal machine via a real Chromium (Playwright) - no Apify, no cost. A residential IP is necessary but not sufficient: both sites also check that the client is a real browser, so a plain HTTP GET fails on any connection.
_browser: headless false opens a visible Chrome window - slower and noisier, but it is the fallback when realestate.com.au's Kasada refuses the headless one. browser_channel null uses the Chromium from 'playwright install chromium'; set it to 'chrome' to drive your own installed Chrome instead.
